_readme: THE CHEMISTRY SAMPLE PAPER — edit this file to change what the Milliy sertifikat
chemistry builder's "Namunaviy variant" button loads. Contract: docs/MILLIY_QUIZ.md.
WHY 40 QUESTIONS AND NOT THE PROGRAMME'S 43. The DTM chemistry paper is two
parts: #1-40 (closed + short typed) in 100 minutes, then #41-43 EXTENDED
WRITTEN work in 80 more. Those last three are marked by a human against
per-step criteria (M = method, A = arithmetic), 25 balls each, and score 0 if
the candidate writes only a final answer. This subsystem auto-grades a slot as
right or wrong, so it cannot mark them and does not pretend to: the sample
paper is part 1 in full. A teacher who wants #41-43 sets them as homework or
marks them on paper.
THE OFFICIAL PART-1 DISTRIBUTION, which this file follows:
Y1 (one correct answer, 32): umumiy 13 - anorganik 6 - organik 10 - tahlil 3
Y2 (matching, 3):            umumiy / anorganik / organik, one each
O1 (short typed answer, 5):  umumiy 2 - anorganik 1 - organik 2
⚠️ NOTHING ENFORCES THAT. There is no chemistry blueprint in this repo (unlike
maths' EXAM_BLUEPRINT) and the builder has no per-section quotas, so the counts
above are this file's own discipline. Recount them if you add or remove an entry.
⚠️ Y2 MATCHING IS AUTHORED AS A CLOSED A-D QUESTION whose options are whole
pairings ("1-b, 2-c, 3-a"), which is how a matching item is printed on the
paper anyway. There is no matching QUESTION TYPE in this repo, and a real
drag-to-match widget would need a new qType in the runner, the review screen
and the grader.
Per entry:
topicId     a `kimyo` TOPIC slug. It becomes the item's sectionId, which is
what the teacher's results page groups by. The taxonomy keeps the
programme's four numbered sections and nothing finer:
umumiy-kimyo
anorganik-kimyo
organik-kimyo
kimyoviy-tahlil
subtopicId  optional, for a more precise label. Must belong to its topic.
Chemistry's subtopics carry a "Group — Leaf" prefix, so they read
e.g. `atom-tuzilishi-izotoplar`.
question    a string, or {uz, ru, en}. A bare string is used for all three.
options     A-D (OptionKey is A..D). PRESENT => closed item; ABSENT => typed
item. There is no separate flag, so the two cannot contradict.
answer      closed -> the correct option key; typed -> the literal answer.
acceptedAnswers  typed only: other spellings graded correct.
numeric     typed only, default FALSE. ⚠️ SET IT TRUE on every calculation
answer — most chemistry short answers are numbers, the opposite
of biology. It grades with the numeric comparison, so a student
typing "5,6" or "5.60" is not marked wrong for formatting.
difficultyId  1 easy | 2 medium | 3 hard. Default 2.
FORMULAS: written as plain text with digits (H2SO4, Fe(OH)3, C2H5OH) rather
than LaTeX subscripts, because the runner renders these strings through the
same LatexRenderer as every other question and unescaped $ or _ would be read
as math. Wrap real maths in $...$ if an entry needs it.
MARKING: none of the values here set what a question is WORTH. Every question
is priced from the share of the cohort that solved it (lib/RASCHmarks.ts) — the
more of the class that gets it right, the less it is worth. `difficultyId` is a
label for the teacher, not a mark.
KNOWN LIMITATION: the questions are authored UZBEK-ONLY. A bare string fills
ru and en with the same Uzbek text (toSampleText), so a student who picked
Russian or English sees Uzbek rather than a blank. Add {uz, ru, en} objects
per entry as translations are made.

questions.question: 44 g karbonat angidrid (CO2) necha mol moddani tashkil etadi?
Normal sharoitda 11,2 l kislorod (O2) gazining massasi qancha?
Izotoplar bir-biridan nima bilan farq qiladi?
questions.explanation: Izotoplarda protonlar (demak zaryad va element) bir xil, massa soni esa neytronlar soni bilan farq qiladi.

questions.question: Tashqi qobig'ida 3s2 3p4 elektronlari bo'lgan element qaysi?
questions.explanation: 1s2 2s2 2p6 3s2 3p4 — jami 16 elektron, ya'ni 16-element oltingugurt.

questions.question: Davriy sistemada guruh bo'yicha yuqoridan pastga tushganda atom radiusi va metallik xossa qanday o'zgaradi?
questions.explanation: Yangi qobiqlar qo'shiladi — radius ortadi, tashqi elektron yadrodan uzoqlashib osonroq beriladi, demak metallik xossa kuchayadi.

questions.question: Etilen (C2H4) molekulasidagi uglerod atomlarining gibridlanish turi va valent burchagi qanday?
questions.explanation: Qo'shbog'li uglerod sp2-gibridlangan, uchta sigma bog' bir tekislikda 120° burchak ostida joylashadi.

questions.question: Quyidagi moddalardan qaysi biri atom kristall panjaraga ega?
questions.explanation: Olmosda har bir uglerod to'rtta kovalent bog' bilan bog'langan — atom panjara, shuning uchun juda qattiq va yuqori haroratda suyuqlanadi.

questions.question: Suvning shunga o'xshash molekulyar massali H2S dan ancha yuqori haroratda qaynashi sababi nima?
questions.explanation: Kislorodning elektromanfiyligi katta — molekulalar orasida vodorod bog'lanish hosil bo'ladi va uni uzish uchun qo'shimcha energiya kerak.

questions.question: N2 + 3H2 ⇌ 2NH3 + Q muvozanat sistemasida bosim oshirilsa va harorat pasaytirilsa muvozanat qayerga siljiydi?
questions.explanation: Mol soni kamayadi (4 → 2), shuning uchun bosim ortishi o'ngga siljitadi; reaksiya ekzotermik, harorat pasayishi ham o'ngga siljitadi.

questions.question: Reaksiya tezligining harorat koeffitsienti 3 ga teng. Harorat 20 °C dan 50 °C ga oshirilsa tezlik necha marta ortadi?
questions.explanation: Van't-Hoff qoidasi: har 10 °C ga 3 marta, 30 °C ga esa 3³ = 27 marta.

questions.question: 40 g suvda 10 g tuz eritilgan. Eritmadagi tuzning massa ulushi qancha?
questions.explanation: Eritma massasi 40 + 10 = 50 g. w = 10/50 · 100 % = 20 %. ⚠️ Erituvchi massasiga bo'lish tipik xato.

questions.question: Quyidagi tuzlardan qaysi birining eritmasi ishqoriy muhitga ega?
questions.explanation: Na2CO3 — kuchli asos va kuchsiz kislota tuzi, anion bo'yicha gidrolizlanadi va muhit ishqoriy (pH > 7) bo'ladi.

questions.question: Quyidagi metallardan qaysi biri mis (II) sulfat eritmasidan misni siqib chiqara olmaydi?
questions.explanation: Kumush kuchlanish qatorida misdan keyin turadi, shuning uchun uni tuz eritmasidan siqib chiqarmaydi.

questions.question: Quyidagi oksidlardan qaysi biri amfoter?
questions.explanation: Al2O3 kislota bilan ham, ishqor bilan ham reaksiyaga kirishadi — amfoter oksid.

questions.question: Ca → CaO → Ca(OH)2 → CaCO3 zanjirining uchinchi bosqichini amalga oshirish uchun qaysi modda kerak?
questions.explanation: Ca(OH)2 + CO2 → CaCO3 + H2O — ishqorning karbonat angidrid bilan reaksiyasi (ohakli suvning loyqalanishi).

questions.question: Suvning karbonat (vaqtinchalik) qattiqligini qaysi usul bilan yo'qotish mumkin?
questions.explanation: Qaynatishda Ca(HCO3)2 parchalanadi: CaCO3 cho'kmaga tushadi, CO2 ajralib chiqadi.

questions.question: Galogenlarning oksidlovchilik xossasi qatorda qanday o'zgaradi: F2 → Cl2 → Br2 → I2?
questions.explanation: Guruh bo'yicha pastga tushganda radius ortib elektromanfiylik kamayadi, demak oksidlovchilik susayadi. Ftor eng kuchli oksidlovchi.

questions.question: Quyidagi o'g'itlardan qaysi biri kaliyli o'g'it hisoblanadi?
questions.explanation: KCl — kaliyli o'g'it. Ammiakli selitra va karbamid azotli, superfosfat esa fosforli o'g'it.

questions.question: Konsentrlangan sulfat kislotaning mis bilan reaksiyasida qanday gaz ajralib chiqadi?
questions.explanation: Konsentrlangan H2SO4 oksidlovchi sifatida ishlaydi: Cu + 2H2SO4 → CuSO4 + SO2 + 2H2O. Vodorod ajralmaydi.

questions.question: Pentan (C5H12) necha xil tuzilish izomeriga ega?
questions.explanation: n-pentan, izopentan (2-metilbutan) va neopentan (2,2-dimetilpropan) — jami 3 ta.

questions.question: Alkanlar uchun eng xarakterli reaksiya turi qaysi?
questions.explanation: Alkanlarda faqat to'yingan sigma bog'lar bor, shuning uchun ular galogenlash kabi o'rin olish (substitutsiya) reaksiyalariga kirishadi.

questions.question: Propenning HBr bilan reaksiyasida asosiy mahsulot qaysi (Markovnikov qoidasi)?
questions.explanation: Markovnikov qoidasi: vodorod ko'p vodorodli uglerodga birikadi, brom esa o'rta uglerodga — 2-bromopropan.

questions.question: Atsetilenni laboratoriyada olishning asosiy usuli qaysi?
questions.explanation: CaC2 + 2H2O → C2H2 + Ca(OH)2 — laboratoriyadagi standart usul.

questions.question: Benzolning nitrolash reaksiyasi uchun qanday aralashma ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: Nitrolash aralashmasi — konsentrlangan nitrat va sulfat kislotalar; H2SO4 suvni tortib olib nitroniy ionini hosil qiladi.

questions.question: Fenolning spirtlardan farqli ravishda ishqorlar bilan reaksiyaga kirishishi sababi nima?

options.B: Benzol halqasi OH guruhning kislotaligini kuchaytiradi

questions.explanation: Aromatik halqa kislorodning elektron juftini o'ziga tortadi, O–H bog' qutblanadi va fenol kuchsiz kislota sifatida ishqor bilan fenolyat hosil qiladi.

questions.question: "Kumush ko'zgu" reaksiyasi qaysi sinf moddalarini aniqlashga xizmat qiladi?
questions.explanation: Aldegidlar Tollens reaktivi (ammiakli kumush oksid eritmasi) bilan oksidlanadi va idish devorida metall kumush qatlami hosil bo'ladi.

questions.question: Etanol va sirka kislotasining kislotali muhitdagi reaksiyasi nima deb ataladi va qanday mahsulot beradi?
questions.explanation: CH3COOH + C2H5OH ⇌ CH3COOC2H5 + H2O — esterifikatsiya, qaytar reaksiya.

questions.question: Saxarozaning gidrolizida qanday moddalar hosil bo'ladi?
questions.explanation: Saxaroza — glyukoza va fruktoza qoldiqlaridan tuzilgan disaxarid.

questions.question: Aminokislotalarning amfoter xossasi nima bilan izohlanadi?

options.C: Amino va karboksil guruhlarning birgalikda borligi bilan

questions.explanation: –COOH kislotali, –NH2 esa asosli xossa beradi, shuning uchun aminokislota kislota bilan ham, ishqor bilan ham reaksiyaga kirishadi.

questions.question: Sulfat ionini (SO4 2−) aniqlash uchun qaysi reaktiv ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: BaCl2 bilan oq, kislotada erimaydigan BaSO4 cho'kmasi hosil bo'ladi.

questions.question: Suv va etanol aralashmasini ajratish uchun qaysi usul qo'llanadi?
questions.explanation: Ikkisi ham suyuqlik va bir-birida to'liq eriydi, ammo qaynash haroratlari farq qiladi (78 °C va 100 °C) — haydash (distillash) kerak.

questions.question: Konsentrlangan sulfat kislotani suv bilan suyultirishda qanday tartibga rioya qilinadi?
questions.explanation: Kislota suvga oz-ozdan, aralashtirib quyiladi: juda ko'p issiqlik ajraladi va teskari tartibda aralashma otilib ketishi mumkin.

questions.question: Moddalarni ular bilan boradigan reaksiya belgisiga moslashtiring: 1) BaCl2 + Na2SO4  2) HCl + NaOH  3) Na2CO3 + HCl. Belgilar: a) gaz ajralishi  b) cho'kma hosil bo'lishi  c) suv hosil bo'lishi.
questions.explanation: BaSO4 — cho'kma; HCl + NaOH — neytrallanib suv beradi; Na2CO3 + HCl — CO2 gazi ajraladi.

questions.question: Oksidlarni turiga moslashtiring: 1) CaO  2) SO3  3) ZnO. Turlari: a) kislotali  b) asosli  c) amfoter.
questions.explanation: CaO — asosli, SO3 — kislotali (H2SO4 beradi), ZnO — amfoter.

questions.question: Moddani sinfiga moslashtiring: 1) C2H5OH  2) CH3COOH  3) CH3CHO. Sinflari: a) aldegid  b) spirt  c) karbon kislota.
questions.explanation: C2H5OH — spirt (–OH), CH3COOH — karbon kislota (–COOH), CH3CHO — aldegid (–CHO).

questions.question: 5,6 g temir yetarli miqdordagi xlor bilan to'liq reaksiyaga kirishdi. Hosil bo'lgan FeCl3 ning massasini hisoblang (g). Javobni son bilan yozing.
KMnO4 + HCl → KCl + MnCl2 + Cl2 + H2O reaksiyasida bitta marganets atomi nechta elektron qabul qiladi? Javobni son bilan yozing.
questions.explanation: KMnO4 da Mn oksidlanish darajasi +7, MnCl2 da +2. +7 → +2 uchun 5 elektron qabul qilinadi, ya'ni marganets oksidlovchi.

questions.question: Ammiak (NH3) molekulasidagi azotning valentligini son bilan yozing.
questions.explanation: Azot uchta vodorod atomi bilan uchta kovalent bog' hosil qiladi — valentligi 3 (oksidlanish darajasi esa −3).

questions.question: CH3–CH(CH3)–CH2–CH3 birikmasining IUPAC nomenklaturasi bo'yicha nomini yozing.
questions.explanation: Eng uzun zanjir 4 uglerodli (butan), ikkinchi uglerodda metil radikali — 2-metilbutan (izopentan).

questions.question: Etilenning polimerlanishidan hosil bo'ladigan polimer nomini yozing.
questions.explanation: nCH2=CH2 → (–CH2–CH2–)n — polietilen, qo'shbog' hisobiga boradigan polimerlanish reaksiyasi.
